An ancient and powerful blade in the hands of a vicious killer.

Unleashes a series of ramping strikes. The final strike launches enemies in the air.
A battle staff handed down to Jingtai from his master. It holds no power, but is deadly in the hands of a skilled warrior.
Strikes all targets in a large cone with searing light.

Fires star shaped blades in a straight line.
A traditional Sametan weapon used to hunt their enemies. &{color:#e45f5f}Damage is reduced by 30% against enemies within 5m.{color:end}
Spurts a globule from Bumaro. Charging increases damage.

A colony of necrotizing amoebas eats away any material they come in contact with. If you can ignore the agonizing pain, the jelly is quite supportive. This weapon leaves a short-lived glob at its landing point.
Casts a bolt of energy. May be charged up to fire three bolts.
One of the numerous weapons made by Zax. He is rather fond of this one. {color:#e45f5f}Damage is reduced by 30% against enemies within 5m.{color:end}
Sweeps blasts of spiritual energy into damaging bolts to strike enemies.
A holy totem awarded by Lilu's spiritual protector. {color:#e45f5f}Damage is reduced by 30% against enemies within 5m.{color:end}
Ignites the air, causing damaging explosions in a short line.
A molten piece of Ignuma's arm that is curved into a wicked blade.
A weaponized form of teleportation that rends reality, leaving accelerated particles in the gaps that burn foes.
Slashes twice and ends with a thrust. Inflicts burning.
A legendary sword of Orrian origin, and bladesister to Magdaer. Originally wielded by Prince Rurik.
Slash forwards twice in an adorable fashion. Attack type changes based on skill use.
Normally soft and fluffy, but frighteningly sharp when bared.
Creates a vacuum at the targetted area, causing a damaging implosion.
Alters the mass of non-living objects, including Ram and Bacchus, to allow devastating attacks.
A kinetic bat used to launch projectiles. Can be charged for higher damage.
Amplifies the kinetic energy of objects it comes into contact with, usually baseballs. {color:#e45f5f}Damage reduced by 30% against targets within 5m.{color:end}
Fires six missiles that fly side-by-side.
Merope is constantly manufacturing micro-rockets as ammunition. {color:#e45f5f}Damage reduced by 30% against targets within 5m.{color:end}
Slashes straight ahead twice with energy blades.
Maia is equipped with repurposed surgical energy blades that are networked into her nervous system, allowing them to react to her actions immediately.
Fires a volley of fan-shaped stone shards that shred enemies.
A mineral from Akum fired through magnetic passages in Tulam's hands.
Unleashes a set of devastating combo punches in a line.
Using an old boxer’s trick, Pancuga has increased his punching impact with liquid mercury.
Throws heavy bundles out to damage enemies. Occasionally slows.
A mysterious sack of wares that seems to be bottomless. It doesn’t seem to work for most of the other Masters. {color:#e45f5f}Deals 30% reduced damage to enemies within 5m.{color:end}
Deadly blades swung in a three-hit combo to inflict poison.
Razor sharp Chakram doused in virulent poisons. A dear possession to Nedien.
Fires short-ranged projectiles in quick succession.
A modified reclamation sub-machinegun, complete with an attachable rocket launcher.
Throws a punch full of Justice. Delivers a drop kick that knocks back when charged.
Delivers a staggering punch filled with righteous justice to put evil-doers to shame.
Unleashes deadly short-ranged attacks. Can destroy incoming projectiles.
The focus of Yuri's offensive and defensive capabilities. A fist of Sol trained with her Cosmic Aegis.
Fire projectiles that mark their target after two strikes and allow Xero to cast skills through them.

A Cube crafted by Xero that projects holographic patterns on his enemies. The pattern burns into their target, allowing him to manipulate their energy. {color:#e45f5f}Deals 30% reduced damage to enemies within 5m.{color:end}
Summons a column of sacred light that damages foes. Can be charged to deal more damage.
This sacred book contains the words of Nura. Anyone who has this book can be recognized as a High-priest and use the power of Nura.
